freeze.purpose: Pre-repair snapshot hashes. Historical files are not rewritten by the audit.
freeze.note: The 160k URL CSV named final_full (1).csv is not in this repository. Phase 1 metrics cannot be regenerated from local evidence.

parquet.interpretation: This table mixes URL-only backbone rows with paired captures and fills missing multimodal features with zero. It is not a fully observed multimodal benchmark. Live labels match the fusion threshold, so agreement with those labels is circular.

crawl.renderer: httpx User-Agent fetch only. No rendered DOM, screenshot, redirect chain, or execution trace is stored in the crawl metadata.
crawl.repeated_profile_protocol: One human fetch and one bot fetch per meta file. H1/B1/H2/B2 repeats are not present.

feature_schema.claimed_63_resolution: 41 URL features + 9 drift + 6 promotional + 5 jargon = 61 detector features. The extra two columns are final_risk_score and model_probability, which are fusion outputs and are excluded from the publication feature set.

visual_features.formula: SSIM and mean absolute pixel difference on 256x192 grayscale screenshots. Default visual_ssim=1 and visual_pixel_delta=0 when screenshots are absent, and have_visual is false so the drift aggregate drops the visual weight.

historical_results.phase1_reason: final_full (1).csv is absent. metrics.json records a prior run whose label column was drift_score. That column is not independent evidence of cloaking.
historical_results.phase1_wording: Archived ensemble ROC-AUC is 0.995309, which is not the same number as HistGradientBoosting ROC-AUC 0.996074. HistGradientBoosting is the best archived Phase 1 model by accuracy and ROC-AUC.
historical_results.phase2_reason: Trained on the mixed 5,122-row table with zero-filled multimodal features and fusion-derived live labels. final_risk_score and model_probability were included as features.
historical_results.phase2_wording: On the archived debugging run, Ensemble_multimodal has the highest accuracy and ROC-AUC, while RF_multimodal has higher recall (0.9968 vs 0.9952). That comparison is not evidence of cloaking detection.
historical_results.synthetic_400_reason: No synthetic corpus, generation script, prediction file, or confusion-matrix artifact for a 400-example evaluation is in the repository.

tasks_separated.url_risk_classification: Not rerun. Source CSV missing. Archived metrics must not be described as confirmed cloaking detection.
tasks_separated.promotional_cloaking_detection: Not established. Paired captures have no independent cloaking labels.
tasks_separated.overt_defacement_detection: Not evaluated. No defacement ground truth is stored.
tasks_separated.controlled_attack_detection: Only fixture-level unit tests exist. The 400-example synthetic result is unsupported.
